one_liner: CivicState turns civic issues into cited official letters, but remains watchlist until paid validation.
directive: Upgrade the missing/thin soul into a VC-grade, honesty-labeled business plan while preserving repo truth and watchlist constraints.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption — operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

sources: dispatch registry note and scrutiny gaps
methods: built bottom-up market and financial model without external claims

planningMethod: EIR diligence synthesis: repo evidence first, assumptions labeled, market model bottom-up, gate remains needs-revision pending operator adoption.

customer.primary: US residents with concrete civic issues who want official contact handled for them
unknowns: issue categories with lowest compliance risk

market.tam: $15,000,000 [assumption: 1,000 markets x 1,000 paid jobs/year x $15 ARPC]
market.sam: $30,000 [assumption: 100 SEO clusters x 1,000 visits/year x 2% conversion x $15 ARPC]
market.method: bottom-up civic-letter job model; no external market claims were treated as evidence

unitEconomics: single tier gross margin 96.0% before processing/labor [evidence: repo price and treasury test]
three-pack gross margin 97.3% before processing/labor [evidence: repo price and treasury test]
full-spread gross margin 97.6% before processing/labor [evidence: repo price and treasury test]

revenueAssumptions: 3% preview-to-paid target [assumption based on planning gate]
0.5% or lower chargeback loss [assumption based on planning constraint]
sensitivityTests: 1% conversion lowers launch-year revenue from $3,600 to $1,200 [assumption]
$500/month local-official data cost lowers 2027 net by $6,000 [assumption]

alternatives: Manual official contact and government web forms

antiPlan.summary: This may be an overbuilt workflow for a task citizens can do for free; watchlist status is justified until paid usage and deliverability are proven.
holes: official data coverage may be stale or expensive
repo identity conflicts with dispatch project id
mitigations: paid beta with payment before delivery
domain warming and per-domain bounce pause
mandatory disclaimers, citation verification, and human review
operator identity ruling before wrk.vc publication
residualRisks: local provider economics may break the low-price model

strategy: Validate one narrow civic-letter wedge before adding community, subscriptions, API access, certified mail, or autonomous follow-up.

goToMarket.first100: 20 beta recruits, 50 concierge campaigns, 30 opt-in public examples, then 100-preview paid beta [assumption]
channels: SEO from opt-in public campaign pages

operatorWorkflow.daily: review flagged submissions, monitor bounces, inspect treasury alerts, handle opt-outs
operatorWorkflow.weekly: review conversion, citation failures, provider coverage, support load
operatorWorkflow.launchConstraint: no live sends without human-reviewed compliance path [assumption]

constraints: workspace-only diligence; no external market research
legal/compliance sensitivity around civic letters and AI citations
Clerk/Stripe/Postmark implementation may conflict with future WrkPlug shared rails
metrics: gross margin after provider and payment costs

aiWorkGovernance.honestyLabels: Every quantitative claim in BUSINESS.md is tagged as evidence or assumption.
aiWorkGovernance.citationPolicy: Letters may cite only verified sources; unverified citations are stripped or flagged.
aiWorkGovernance.humanReview: Threats, defamation risk, unverifiable claims, and all flagged items require operator review before sending.
aiWorkGovernance.disclosures: AI disclosure and not-legal-advice disclaimer are required in letter content.

unknowns: whether public asset is CivicState or brooks-history
whether operator wants this pitched as a business

assumptionLedger.test: reuse of official/citation data by campaign count

assumptionLedger.claim: WrkPlug shared rails reduce duplicated costs
